summary: Decode a NativeImage from encoded/raw buffer data with Electron options.

target.notes: Requires an image codec/native image wrapper, not Chromium.

semantics.options: width/height/scaleFactor may affect raw bitmap interpretation

caveats: Node Buffer-to-byte[] lowering must preserve exact bytes.
Raw bitmap inputs require dimensions; encoded formats must be decoded by compatible codecs.

tests.name: decode PNG buffer
tests.expected_behavior: returns decoded image when buffer format is supported

tests.name: invalid bytes
tests.expected_behavior: returns/behaves as Electron NativeImage does for invalid image data; do not expose arbitrary decoder-specific exceptions without compatibility handling
